title: Lanterns, charging, suit pick sheet
desc: No new design: lantern charge rounds C1-C3 and H1-H3 and the 5x5 suit grid rendered as sheets for J to pick from.

takes.name: Oath kneel
takes.facts: pass 219: kneel on the ring knee, ring fist to the port; 8 s charge (160 ticks), flare, settle to 190

takes.name: Lantern raised
takes.facts: pass 219: standing, lantern held up by its handle

takes.name: Both knees
takes.facts: pass 219: both knees, both hands round the lantern

takes.name: Steady press
takes.facts: pass 220: hanging pendulum lantern, fist meets the port, leans ~10 deg for the charge

takes.name: Punch in
takes.facts: pass 220: hanging lantern, punch into the port

takes.name: Steadied
takes.facts: pass 220: hanging lantern, steadied with the free hand
